items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: It was on a label called Bandwagon. That's Roger Wolfe. It was Roger Wolfe, the old disc jockey from WDSU. It was his label.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Speaking of records, what about records with bands where you function as a sideman, with any sessions that you think, either from your point of view or as a whole were more outstanding than others that you can think of offhand?
Well, I think some of the sessions that I made with Sharky were very good from a real Dixieland standpoint.
